latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the skill authoring framework.

- Defines "iron laws" to separate reusable skill logic from project-local context.
- Provides a structured workflow for creating, organizing, and validating skills.
- Establishes clear phase-based authoring steps, from defining boundaries to applying completion gates.
- Outlines when and where to use references, scripts, tests, and self-healing.
- Includes guidance for maintaining fresh-agent usability.
- Supplies a reference skill as a model implementation.
